description: SIM98 — CMSTG Joint plikHM CMB + BAO Parameter Fit. Replaces SIM90's approximate Gaussian CMB prior with the official Planck 2018 plikHM TTTEEE likelihood. Minimises chi2_total = -2lnL(plikHM) + chi2_BAO over (H0, Omega_m) for LCDM and (H0, Omega_m, Lambda0) for CMSTG. Expected result: Δ(-2lnL) ~ 0 at the CMB-optimised CMSTG parameter point.

optimizer.note: Max 80 CLASS calls per model. Start from SIM97 joint best-fit and Planck LCDM.

class.note: k_per_decade=20 (reduced from 50) for optimization speed. Final evaluation uses 50.

bao_data.note: BOSS DR12 + eBOSS DR16 + Lyα — same as SIM87. 12 data points, full 12x12 covariance.

acceptance.note: PASS if |Delta(-2lnL)(CMSTG_joint - LCDM)| < 5 at the SIM98 best-fit parameters.
